notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
Xavier Sal does not have summoning sickness.
Scurry Oak has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
description:
Activate Xavier Sal's second ability by tapping it and sacrificing any other creature you control, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
When the Squirrel enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite +1/+1 counters on Scurry Oak, you may instead use Xavier Sal's first ability to get infinite copies of creature tokens you control.
